user.title: Water heater
user.description: Select the main entities of your electric water heater and its regulator. TankWise will learn how the tank behaves and how hot water is used.

data_description.temperature_sensor: Temperature probe in the upper part of the tank.
data_description.power_sensor: Power currently drawn by the water heater.
data_description.heater_switch: Switch that feeds the water heater (it must always stay on).
data_description.manual_mode_switch: Switch that makes the regulator heat at full power (e.g. FreeDS manual mode).
data_description.price_sensor: Purchase price sensor, e.g. PVPC with the hourly prices of today and tomorrow as attributes.

inputs.title: Recommended and optional inputs
inputs.description: These inputs improve the learning and the plan. All of them can be changed later in the options.

data.master_entity: Regulator is master of the water heater

data_description.energy_sensor: Recommended. Cumulative energy of the water heater (total or total increasing). Without it, the power is integrated.
data_description.regulator_sensor: PWM output of the regulator (e.g. FreeDS). Helps to tell a thermostat cut-off from a regulator stop.
data_description.master_entity: Entity that is on when the regulator controls the water heater.
data_description.occupancy_entity: When off, no demand is expected and those days are not learned.
data_description.injection_price_sensor: Recommended. Price paid for the energy exported to the grid.
data_description.grid_import_sensor: Recommended. Total energy imported from the grid.
data_description.grid_export_sensor: Recommended. Total energy exported to the grid.
data_description.export_power_sensor: Recommended. Power being exported to the grid right now.
data_description.ambient_sensor: Temperature of the room where the tank is. Without it, the fixed value of the options is used.
data_description.workday_entity: Binary sensor of the Workday integration. With it, holidays are learned apart from workdays and appointments can be set for workdays or holidays.

reconfigure.title: Change the main entities
reconfigure.description: Select the main entities of the water heater. The learned data is kept.

data_description.price_sensor: Purchase price sensor, e.g. PVPC with the hourly prices of today and tomorrow as attributes.

data_description.water_region: Used to estimate the mains water temperature of each day. It can be fixed by hand with the 'Mains water temperature' number.

advanced.name: Advanced options
advanced.description: Initial values of what TankWise learns and settings of the usage profile. The defaults suit most installations.

data.profile_mode: Group days of the usage profile
data.profile_days: Days of each type in the usage profile

data_description.rated_power: It is then learned from the power sensor.
data_description.cutoff_temperature: It is then learned from the detected cut-offs.
data_description.profile_days: More days give a steadier forecast when usage changes from one day to the next; fewer days adapt faster.

data.master_entity: Regulator is master of the water heater

data_description.regulator_sensor: PWM output of the regulator (e.g. FreeDS). Helps to tell a thermostat cut-off from a regulator stop.

data_description.workday_entity: Binary sensor of the Workday integration. With it, holidays are learned apart from workdays and appointments can be set for workdays or holidays.

appointments.title: Hot water appointments
appointments.description: Times when hot water must be ready, with a minimum amount of water (at most six).

data_description.liters: Litres at the shower temperature (40 °C by default) that must be available when the block starts to cover the whole block without reheating. The 'suggested litres' sensor shows what the block usually uses.
data_description.days: Workdays and holidays need the Workday sensor.
data_description.duration: Time the hot water use lasts after the appointment (e.g. 60 min for a morning shower, 180 min for the evening showers).
